subject.title: Add Herdr state bridge for OpenClaw TUI

question: Should Herdr pane-state reporting be accepted as a bundled plugin-gated TUI integration, explicit core-owned Herdr behavior, or moved outside core until a generic TUI status seam exists?
rationale: The PR mixes a bundled plugin manifest with core TUI env-triggered startup, and the repository vision keeps optional integrations plugin-owned unless a missing core API is the real work.

options.title: Gate Through Plugin Policy
options.body: Continue the PR only if sidecar startup honors resolved herdr-state activation, including global disablement, denylist, allowlist, and per-plugin disablement.

options.title: Make It Core-Owned
options.body: Remove the misleading plugin shell and document Herdr as explicit core TUI behavior with env controls and live proof.

options.title: Move Outside Core
options.body: Pause or close this PR unless a generic TUI status/plugin lifecycle seam is needed for external Herdr integration.

recommendation.title: Gate Through Plugin Policy
recommendation.body: Continue the PR only if sidecar startup honors resolved herdr-state activation, including global disablement, denylist, allowlist, and per-plugin disablement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across TUI lifecycle and plugin policy/docs surfaces that define this product boundary.
